customManagers.description: komodo-periphery's add-on version is the upstream Periphery version (plus an optional -rN suffix, dropped on a bump)
trivy-watch's add-on version is the Trivy version its Dockerfile is FROM (plus an optional -rN suffix, dropped on a bump)

packageRules.description: A Periphery bump needs a CHANGELOG entry; the PR is a reminder, not an automerge

Trivy: the Dockerfile's FROM and trivy-watch's add-on version move in one PR (CI fails if they disagree). Releases wait 14 days, since Trivy's own release pipeline was compromised in early 2026; the PR also needs a CHANGELOG entry
Don't chase GitHub runner versions: the build runners sit in the job matrix, which Renovate can't update, so a bump would only move the lint job
